name: Research Reviewer Rejected — Spawn Source-Curator
description: When the research-reviewer terminates with decide(action=insufficient), spawn the source-curator role to evaluate whether the gap is a corpus problem (add sources, wait for indexing, emit curator artifact, decide indexed) OR a research-side issue (decide needs_clarification with retry hint). Replaces the prior researcher-with-source-acquisition retry path under ADR-040 — the curator owns substrate-curation, the researcher stays pure (read curator artifact when present, query, emit). The cognitive-load split was the empirical motivator (smoke #8 run-13 trajectories, ADR-040 §'Why this exists').

on_enter.subject: agent.task.source-curator
on_enter.prompt:
The research-reviewer at loop $entity.instance terminated with decide(action=insufficient). Read the reviewer's reason via read_loop_result on $entity.instance and classify the gap.

If the reviewer's reason names a corpus gap (a topic, package, file path, symbol, or concept the existing corpus does not cover): call add_source_repo for each named source, wait for indexing (poll via query_entity until expected entity IDs resolve), then call emit_curator_artifact with the verified entity IDs (and source_dirs if the deployment uses the SemSource shared mount) and terminate with decide(action="indexed", reason="<one-sentence summary of coverage added>"). The next researcher loop will re-attempt the original research with the augmented corpus.

If the reviewer's reason is a research-side issue (the researcher dropped a field, didn't query something obvious, or asked for something the existing corpus already covers): do NOT add sources and do NOT call emit_curator_artifact. Terminate with decide(action="needs_clarification", reason="<why the corpus isn't the issue>", retry_hint="<concrete instruction for the next researcher>"). The framework spawns a fresh researcher with your hint via rule 02c.

When ambiguous: prefer needs_clarification. Adding sources speculatively burns approval-gate cost; the researcher can re-query the existing corpus at zero substrate cost.

metadata.stop_condition: Q2 — MaxIter (=5) + reviewer + opt-in human gate
metadata.max_iterations_note: Same per-entity rule-state caveat as the prior 02-reviewer-rejected-retry-with-source.json rule. Each reviewer loop is a new entity, so the budget is informational; the curator's max_iterations=3 is the actionable bound on a single curator pass.
metadata.supersedes: configs/rules/research-mode-transition/02-reviewer-rejected-retry-with-source.json (ADR-031 R3.2.2 — researcher-with-source-acquisition path, hard-replaced by ADR-040)
metadata.lineage_forwarding: related_loops.researcher is forwarded from the reviewer's lineage so the curator can read_loop_result on the prior researcher's artifact when classifying. The curator then decides indexed (rule 02b spawns a fresh researcher) or needs_clarification (rule 02c spawns a fresh researcher); both downstream rules drop the lineage.researcher forward per the supersession invariant (the new researcher is the new artifact author).
